## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `07e672183d2728b1ac2d51cae149ab00772f7ece`
Local-runs: none
Scope: ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/app-bundle.ts (`AppBundleStore`: `enter`, `read`, `holds`, `holdsType`, `markStale`, `clear`, `ask`; `indexAppBundle`), ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts (`ObjectStackAdapter.loadAppBundle`, `requestAppBundle`, `installBundledItemReads`, `fetchObjectSchemaFresh` reading the bundle first with `requestObjectSchema` split out, `cacheKeyNamesBundledItem`, the `invalidateCache` / `invalidateViewKeys` / `clearCache` hooks), ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx (the `loadAppBundle` effect on the URL-named app), the README and content/docs/frontend/data-objectstack.mdx prose, the three new test files and the three adapted verdict suites, .changeset/27627-console-app-metadata-bundle.md

Inputs: card #27627 (the Seam card; the console-half claim 6538126238 split beside the producer claim 6538108232; the amendments 6541997127 (producer #28287 merged, closing keyword `Fixes`, owed: merge main, switch to the conditional `getAppBundle`, bind `AppMetadataBundleResponseSchema`) and 6542521727 (Clause-② re-measured `yes (widening)` on the built declarations); the dev reports 6539052883 and 6542507828 with the withheld-vs-outside deviation the seat and spec seat 1 agreed), PR #28321 (body with the before and after request table measured through the record page's acceptance transport, the acceptance notes, the file list of 12 files, the diff of 955 lines against `main` read whole for every hand-written hunk, 9 commits from the merge-base), the 68 check-runs on this head (read 2026-10-31T11:17Z: all 68 runs completed, none failed, none cancelled, none in progress; success: Build & E2E UI, Build Docs, Build UI Deps, Check Changeset, Check Documentation Links, Dogfood Regression Gate, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Lint & Repo Gates, Lint UI, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Live E2E UI, PR-body guards (claim · duplicate · Part-of · single-writer path), Plan Test Core shards, Spec property liveness, Test Core, Test Core (all 8), Test UI, Test UI (all 16), Type Check UI, Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · debt ledger, Type Check · source gates, Type Check · workspace, TypeScript Type Check, filter; skipped: 18.x upgrade harness (opt-in), Auto Label, Build Core, Check PR Size, Dogfood Regression Gate (matrix shard/3), Dogfood Verify CLI, Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in), Schedule gate · skip when a green push run covers the commit, Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL), UI Published Artifacts), and the tree on `main` for the producer (#28287 merged as 8441a012: `packages/client` `meta.getAppBundle(appId, { ifNoneMatch })` answering `{ data, etag: { value, weak }, notModified }`, `packages/spec/src/api/app-bundle.zod.ts` `AppMetadataBundleResponseSchema`, the bare body with `app`, `objects`, `views`, `pages`, `dashboards` as `GetMetaItemResponse` envelopes, the per-caller read gate and the weak `ETag`, `no-store` when a member's field visibility is undetermined, as the lane's PASS 6540468220 on that PR recorded), the adapter's existing `installViewListShare` wrap shape and `MetadataCache` lifetime. The head is mergeable and clean against today's `main`; `RecordDetailView.tsx` moved on `main` since the merge-base (#28392) outside this PR's one test file on that view.

### ① Derived judgments

- **One door, no dual path for a bundled item** - right. `client.meta.getItem(type, name)` is the one door `getView`, `getPage`, `getApp`, `getItems`, `probeMetaItemAccess` and app-shell's `MetadataProvider` go through, and `installBundledItemReads` answers it from the active bundle as a copy of the item's own envelope, falling through to the route for an item the bundle does not hold or any call with options; `fetchObjectSchemaFresh`, the one read outside the SDK, asks the bundle first and keeps its unwrap and `disabledActions` / `sortability` stamping, so a bundled object carries what its by-name read gave it (pinned on `sortability`). A read made while the bundle is in flight waits for it, which is what makes the cold open one wave.
- **The bundle is the caller's own, and absence is answered by the route** - right, and it is the right reading of the order's "withheld" line. The producer builds every member through the same per-caller gate and names nothing it withheld, so an absent name cannot be told from an item outside the app; the adapter sends it by name, and the route answers that item's own refusal. No item is answered from a bundle it is not in, and no refusal is invented client-side.
- **Staying current is bounded by the server's validator** - right. A write through any client write door marks every bundle stale once it settles, whatever it wrote; an `invalidateCache(key)` naming a held item in any of the cache-key spellings the adapter and its hosts use (bare object name, `view:OBJECT:NAME`, `TYPE:NAME`, `list:TYPE`), an `invalidateViewKeys` of a held view, or an answer older than the adapter cache's lifetime makes the next bundled read revalidate first with `If-None-Match`, the validator rebuilt byte-for-byte from the client's `{ value, weak }` (`W/` included, pinned). A `304` keeps the bundle; `clearCache()` (organization, session, locale) drops items and validator so the next read downloads with no validator, which is what makes a locale switch refetch a body that varies on `Accept-Language`. An answer that arrives after a `clear()` belongs to the old world and is dropped.
- **`no-store` is honoured without a `Cache-Control` read** - right. The client exposes no `Cache-Control`, and the producer serves exactly one `200` without an `ETag`, its `no-store` answer; the adapter reads the missing validator as that case, answers the reads waiting on it, and keeps nothing, so a later read goes by name until the app is entered again (pinned). The adapter's own `MetadataCache` still keeps a definition read during that open for its lifetime, as it does for a by-name answer today, which this PR does not change.
- **Only the URL-named app is entered** - right. `AppContent` loads `matchedApp.name` by the app's name, as the route addresses it; a pseudo-route's fallback app is not entered, so Setup and the marketplace load no bundle, and a host adapter without `loadAppBundle` is left alone. The three verdict suites' probe counts were protected by answering the bundle as refused before the probe regex runs, with their assertions unchanged.
- **The widening is what the declaration of record says** - right. The built `@object-ui/data-objectstack` declarations gain one public member, `ObjectStackAdapter.loadAppBundle(appId: string): Promise<void>`; `AppBundleStore` and `indexAppBundle` are not exported, and app-shell's declarations add nothing. Nothing a metadata author writes changes and no spec path moves, so `Metadata-protocol: none` holds.
- **Pins both ways** - right. Eleven cases through the real adapter and client over a held transport, two acceptance cases on the record page's real adapter (cold: one bundle read and one page request in wave one; warm: one page request and zero metadata requests, the 动态 stream's data reads counted apart), two on a real `AppContent` mount, and five ablations across heads each reddening the cases they should and restored byte-identical.
- **Check-runs as gate verdicts** - read as above; every run on this head completed and none is red, cancelled or in progress at the read.

### ② Semver level

- **`@object-ui/data-objectstack` and `@object-ui/app-shell` patch** - accepted. A ui package takes `patch` for a non-protocol widening; `Clause-②: yes (widening)` names the one new public member, and nothing is narrowed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Live boot not measured** - the acceptance counts come from the record page's real adapter over its acceptance transport, which serves the bundle with a weak `ETag` and `private, no-cache` as the route does; no live server was booted. A server without the route answers `404` and every read keeps its route (pinned). Worth one live open on a cloud box when the seat next has one, recorded on the card, not owed before landing.
- **A bundled read older than the cache lifetime costs one `304` round trip** - by design, the same lifetime the by-name answers it replaces had; not a regression.
- **Studio, the preview client and list reads are unchanged** - as the body says; the bundle serves by-name item reads only.
- **The seat lands** - no Tier H path (no `docs/adr`, no `skills/**`, 955 lines), no human gate; the spec names it binds were approved by the maintainer at 09:30Z (6541747154).

### ④ Design judgment

- Tried: two apps entered in one session (the last entered answers reads; re-entering the first revalidates, not downloads); an invalidation key of a type the bundle holds none of (`holdsType` false, nothing marked); a write door that rejects (`finally` still marks stale, which is the safe side); a `getItem` with an `options` object of `{}` (goes to the route, by the `undefined` test, which is the conservative reading). Keying the whole thing on the server's validator and gate, with no client-side guess about withheld items, is what keeps this consumer from inventing authority it does not have. Nothing to add.

**Verdict reasoning.** The console enters an app with one request and from then on answers every by-name read of a bundled item from the caller's own bundle through the one door those reads share, with absence left to the route, currency bounded by the server's validator through every write and invalidation door the adapter has, `no-store` honoured, only the URL-named app entered, the one new public member declared with the right level, the pins measuring the card's acceptance on the real adapter, and every check on this head green or skipped.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-xoio4p`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:控制台进入一个应用时,用一个请求取回该应用的元数据包;之后打开记录,包里有的对象、视图、页面不再逐个请求。热会话打开记录 0 个元数据请求,冷会话 1 个,与页面请求同一波发出。
- 为什么改:#27627 Target 3 的控制台半边(「27627 插队」),生产方 #28287 已合并;本 PR 收尾并关闭卡片。
- 风险与回滚:只改 ui 的 `data-objectstack` 和 `app-shell`;包里没有的条目照旧走单条路由,服务端无此路由时行为同现在;任何元数据写入都让包先重新校验。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`data-objectstack/src/app-bundle.ts`(存放、校验、失效)与 `index.ts` 的 `installBundledItemReads`。
- 两分钟验证:打开一个应用里的记录,网络面板只见 1 个页面请求,不再有 5 个 `/meta/object/…`。
- 需要你做的:合并需要你在席位线程里说一句(会话安全审核不认常设授权)。
- 席位意见:同意。对外只多一个适配器方法 `loadAppBundle`(条款② 放宽),契约复审 PASS 在案。
